summary: Embeds the frozen notes (cleanBody), every eval prompt alone (P|id) and with its last 3 exchanges (H|id), and the two gate criteria (CRIT|true/false) with EmbeddingGemma 2, EmbeddingGemma 1 and granite-small-r2 on CPU via transformers.js, writing work/vectors/<model>.{json,f32}; models cache in eval/recall/model-cache/. EmbeddingGemma 1 must go through AutoModel's sentence_embedding output (pooling + dense layers live inside its ONNX graph) — the feature-extraction pipeline would skip them; gemma2 uses the pipeline with mean pooling. Symptom fixed this session: granite-small crashed with 'Tile output tensor would require more than 4294967296 bytes' at /model/global_attn_mask/Tile — its ONNX builds a batch×L×L attention mask, so any text ≥1500 chars is now embedded one at a time (batching only changes speed, not vectors).
